area_description: Changes to how flights, airports and air traffic are run.

idea_types.name: Flight-operations efficiency
idea_types.description: A tool or method that helps airlines fly with less fuel, such as better route planning, weight management or fuel planning.

rules.why_it_applies: Sets how aircraft may be operated, which governs any change to how flights are planned or flown.
Sets the common rules every aircraft must follow in the air.
Sets how air traffic services work, which matters for any change that affects routes, climbs or descents.

rules.document: Environmental protection: aviation and the environment overview
rules.why_it_applies: Explains ICAO's environmental work and how its measures fit together.

readiness_checklist: Plain description of what the tool changes in a flight
Fuel or CO2 saving, with data and method
Which airline roles use it and when
Data sources and how reliable they are
Plan to test it on a few flights first
reviewer_questions: How much fuel does it save per flight, measured how?
Does the change affect safety margins?
Who in the airline has to change what they do?
How good is the data it relies on?
What happens when it gives a bad suggestion?
idea_types.national_requirements: Check with your civil aviation authority for the national requirements that also apply.

idea_types.name: Airport and ground operations
idea_types.description: Equipment or methods used on the ground, such as electric ground vehicles, airport energy systems or faster turnaround.

rules.why_it_applies: Sets the standards for airfields and what may be built or operated on them.
Sets security standards that apply to airports, aircraft and anything used on them.

rules.document: Environmental protection: aviation and the environment overview
rules.why_it_applies: Explains ICAO's environmental work and how its measures fit together.

readiness_checklist: Description of the equipment or method
Where on the airport it would be used
Safety on the apron and near aircraft
Security checks for people and items involved
Energy or emissions saved, with data
reviewer_questions: Does it fit safely among aircraft and vehicles?
How are people and items using it security-checked?
What emissions or fuel does it save?
What does the airport need to install?
idea_types.national_requirements: Check with your civil aviation authority for the national requirements that also apply.

idea_types.name: Air traffic and airspace improvements
idea_types.description: Ideas that make flights shorter or smoother, such as new approach or climb procedures and better use of airspace.

rules.why_it_applies: Sets how air traffic services work, which matters for any change that affects routes, climbs or descents.
Sets the common rules every aircraft must follow in the air.
Sets how aircraft may be operated, which governs any change to how flights are planned or flown.

rules.document: Environmental protection: aviation and the environment overview
rules.why_it_applies: Explains ICAO's environmental work and how its measures fit together.

readiness_checklist: Description of the procedure or tool
Which airspace or airports it covers
Fuel and time saved, with method
Plan to test or simulate it
reviewer_questions: Who controls the airspace this changes?
How is safety shown to be maintained?
What training would controllers and pilots need?
Can it be tested before live use?
idea_types.national_requirements: Check with your civil aviation authority for the national requirements that also apply.
